  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  OCTOBER 17, 2020

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor McKeown at 2:00 p.m., on
  Saturday, October 17, 2020, via teleconference pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 at
  https://primetime.bluejeans.com/a2m/live-event/vkfjrujg

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Kevin McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Terry O’Day (arrived at 2:03 p.m.)
  Councilmember Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Ana M. Jara
  Councilmember Kristin McCowan
  Councilmember Ted Winterer

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Lane Dilg
  Interim City Attorney George Cardona
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 2:00 p.m., with all
  members present except Mayor Pro Tem O’Day.

  CONSENT CALENDAR:  All items were considered and approved in one motion unless removed by a
  Councilmember for discussion.
  (Mayor Pro Tem O’Day
  arrived at 2:03 p.m.)  There were no members of the public present to comment on the Consent
  Calendar.

  At the request of Councilmember Winterer, Item 3.A. was removed from
  the Consent Calendar.

  3.A.  Approval of Separation/Retirement Agreement No. 11097
  (CCS) for Chief of Police, was presented.

  Recommended Action
  Staff recommends that Council:
  (1) approve the agreement with Cynthia Renaud for her
  separation/retirement from her position as Chief of Police; and,
  (2) authorize the Interim City Manager to sign the
  separation/retirement agreement on behalf of the City.

  This item was pulled to ask questions of staff including: Why was four

  1  October 17, 2020
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 00F67ECA-2A9D-4B37-AF8A-83227E123852

  months decided for the severance pay; would the Chief be required by the
  severance agreement to participate in any interviews stemming to review
  the events of May 31st above and beyond the OIR report; is there any
  reason to believe she would not respond favorably to being asked to
  participate in any subsequent interviews; and, would it be possible to add a
  requirement to include participating in sworn statements.

  Considerable discussion ensued on topics including, but not limited to:
  would like to have some assurance as part of the severance agreement, that
  the Chief will participate in any investigation that stems from the incidents
  of May 31st;

  Motion by Councilmember Winterer, seconded by Councilmember Jara, to
  approve the staff recommendations that the agreement include with the
  modification some language about cooperating with any additional
  investigation about the events of May 31st.

  The City Attorney read the proposed amended language to the proposed
  agreement. “To include in the obligation, that she participate in interviews
  with and provide materials reasonably requested by the city in connection
  with the OIR group review of events leading up to and including May 31st,
  any subsequent investigations, and any litigation.”

  The motion was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Jara, Winterer, Davis, Himmelrich,
  McCowan, Mayor Pro Tem O’Day, Mayor McKeown
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT: None

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 2:17 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Denise Anderson-Warren  Kevin McKeown
  City Clerk  Mayor

  2  October 17, 2020
